**Overview

**We are seeking an experienced site-based Project Manager and Site Lead to oversee daily project execution in the Project Execution department. The role integrates production, schedule management, commercial controls, and collaboration with NNPR. Reporting to the PMO, you will lead both the Core Team and Site Team to ensure project objectives are met. You will coordinate across functional roles including construction management, planning, controlling, and QA/QC HSE.

**Responsibilities

**

• 
Manage overall project delivery and daily site execution, including staffing, subcontractors, work fronts, and work prioritization.

• 
Lead weekly Core Team and Site Team meetings to ensure realistic work plans, production follow-up, and issue resolution.

• 
Serve as Beritech’s primary operational contact to NNPR, facilitating clear decisions, agreements, meeting minutes, and follow‐up.

• 
Ensure timely documentation of changes, delays, and impacts via Dalux EWN, manage CAN/CO processes, and provide input for time and payment claims.

• 
Own project budget, forecasts, risk registers, and management reporting; track hours, quantities, changes, and invoicing basis with controller and planner.

• 
Coordinate technical releases with the technical project manager and oversee HSE, QA/QC, testing, documentation, and final handover activities.

• 
Identify and escalate obstacles and interface issues promptly to maintain project momentum and align stakeholder expectations.

**Required Education

**Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Marine Engineer or a related field is required.

**Required Experience

**Minimum 7-10 years of proven experience leading large mechanical installations, preferably process piping or pharma projects, with strong site planning, production control, and multidisciplinary coordination. Demonstrated expertise in interpreting contracts, quantity accounting, change management, and documenting schedule and cost impacts is essential. Living close to Køge to commute to site. Danish and english is a requirement.

**Additional Requirements

**Fluent written and verbal Danish and English; experience with Dalux software and systematic reporting tools. Ability to travel daily to the project site in Køge. HSE certification and valid construction safety training are required.

**

Site Management

Production Planning

Contract Administration

Team Leadership

As a Consulting Solution Architect for the Data Management domain, you will serve as a trusted advisor throughout consulting engagements — helping clients shape feasible solution options, leading or supporting the design of custom, high‑value solutions, and ensuring strong domain integrity aligned with the broader SimCorp One solution design. You will play a central role in supporting scalable, high‑quality custom implementations and contribute to consistency and excellence across our Consulting organization.

You will collaborate closely with colleagues across Consulting, Product Management, and Value Streams to ensure our custom solutions remain both feasible and aligned to SimCorp standards. You will also help advance our practices, strengthen our knowledge base, and mentor the next generation of solutioning talent within SimCorp.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As SimCorp embarks on the SimCorp One journey, the Consulting Solution Architect plays a critical role in enabling the Consulting organization to deliver high‑quality, scalable custom solutions. Consulting Solution Architects ensure that custom client requirements are shaped and delivered with strong domain integrity, consistency, and alignment with SimCorp’s delivery methodologies (Compass) and the SimCorp One solution.

You will:

• Influence key architectural decisions in strategic and complex consulting projects

• Strengthen our consulting methodologies and enablement efforts

• Contribute to the evolution of consulting solution best practices and patterns

Our new Consulting Solution Architects bring deep domain experience within the scope of the Data Management Sub-Service Line and the consulting skills needed to act as trusted advisors to internal and external clients.

This is a global position, with potential locations across SimCorp offices worldwide. International travel may be required based on client needs. The role reports to the Global Practice Lead.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

****Global Practice Ownership

**

• Own the Global consulting practice within your domain. This includes ownership of the global consulting artifacts for your domain.

• Contribute with structured feedback into standards evolution.

• Shape and define our consulting practice within your domain.

• Support the enablement of consultants to deliver custom client solutions with high quality, consistency, and aligned with the SimCorp One solution.

**Scoping & Advisory

**

• Lead or support domain‑specific consulting scoping during sales and early project phases for complex and strategic consulting engagements

• Act as the key advisor for solution options and custom feasibility

• Collaborate with Sales, Engagement Leads, Product Management, and Value Streams

• Define and validate custom architecture and design in complex and strategic client projects

• Ensure custom build quality and provide ongoing design assurance

• Resolve domain-specific challenges in collaboration with consulting, value streams, and product teams

**Knowledge Enablement

**

• Document and disseminate domain knowledge and best practices

• Support onboarding and capability building within Consulting

• Collaborate on cross‑functional learning initiatives

**Collaboration & Influence

**

• Work closely with Product Management, Value Streams, and project teams

• Represent your domain in discussions on solution direction and domain challenges

• Interface with clients, including senior stakeholders, on custom solution matters

**Mentoring & Community Leadership

**

• Coach consultants and aspiring architects

• Help grow solutioning maturity within Consulting

• Influence cross‑domain architecture discussions and knowledge sharing

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to excel at several of the following skills and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest.

• Relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics or a relevant Business degree

• At least 7+ years of proven experience designing and implementing SimCorp Dimension solutions

• Deep business knowledge within the Data Management domain. Experience with the SimCorp Data Management Core solution and the SimCorp Data Management Service is a plus.

• Understanding of our clients’ general business processes and operating model

• International experience and global mindset

• Have been involved in several SimCorp Dimension implementations from the early stages of the project

• Ability to build relationships, drive discussions and impact stakeholders when required

• Engagement in partnering with various parts of the SimCorp organization

• Proactiveness, creativeness and commercial mindedness with a global perspective

• Proficiency in English

**Benefits

**SimCorp offers several benefits that might play a significant factor in considering whether to accept a job offer. Since SimCorp operates in 30+ offices worldwide, the benefits package may vary from country to country.

Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please click below to apply. For further information about the position, please contact Kasper Bøgh Larsen, Global Practice Lead Data and Post Trade or Hanna Brzózka, Lead Talent Acquisition Partner at hanna.brzozka@simcorp.com to learn more about the vacancy, recruitment process or SimCorp internal transfer policy.

**Please note that only applications sent through our Workday system will be processed.

Are you passionate about software architecture and motivated by shaping the technology foundation behind innovative energy solutions? Do you enjoy defining architecture strategies, influencing technology direction, and solving complex technical challenges across embedded, cloud, and connectivity platforms?

At DEIF A/S, we develop advanced control solutions that keep power stable and efficient – whether from wind, solar, or traditional sources. With more than 700 employees worldwide, we set new standards in energy efficiency and power conversion, working every day to become the market leader in intelligent energy control. Together, we create solutions that Improve Tomorrow.

**About The Job

**As System Architect, Software, you will play a key role in defining and driving the software architecture that supports DEIF's controllers, connectivity, and cloud solutions – and as part of this you will also spearhead our Cyber Security efforts.

You will help shape the future technological direction of DEIF by establishing architecture principles, defining reference architectures, and guiding development teams in creating secure, scalable, and maintainable software solutions.

Working closely with software architects, hardware architects, product architects, development teams, and other key stakeholders, you will ensure that technology decisions support both current product development and DEIF's long-term ambitions.

This is a unique opportunity to influence the architecture behind innovative energy solutions used by customers worldwide and contribute to technologies that support a more sustainable future.

Read more about DEIF’s performance and strategic initiatives and goals here .

**

• Define and drive the software architecture strategy across Controllers, Connectivity, and Cloud platforms

• Ensure architecture decisions support business objectives, scalability, security, and maintainability

• Collaborate with software, hardware, and product architects to create a unified technology roadmap

**Your profile

**You are an experienced Software Architect who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to influence and set direction across a large engineering organisation. You communicate complex technical concepts clearly, build alignment among stakeholders, and are comfortable challenging existing approaches when better solutions exist.

You possess the credibility, assertiveness, and collaborative mindset needed to drive architectural decisions across Controllers, Connectivity, and Cloud platforms while ensuring long-term scalability, security, and business value.

**Furthermore, You

**

• Have 5-7 years experience with software architecture and modern software development

• Bring expertise in cloud technologies, cyber security, and scalable software design

• Have experience with embedded systems, connectivity solutions, and/or AI technologies

• Possess strong programming skills in technologies such as C++, C#, or Java

• Enjoy influencing technical direction and collaborating across disciplines

• Communicate fluently in English

You’ll experience a professional and highly engaged working environment, where we’re curious on each other’s perspectives and encourage respectful, honest dialogue that drives growth. Our strength lies in responsibility, teamwork, and the courage to innovate – that’s what drives us forward.

In addition to a role filled with exciting challenges, we offer you:

• The opportunity to shape software platforms and products used globally

**About TimeLog

TimeLog is a leading Professional Services Automation (PSA) software, dedicated to helping professional service organizations streamline business processes and boost productivity. TimeLog fills the GAP between Project Managers and the Finance Department in the consulting business, empowering Project Managers to manage project financials in a way compliant with the requirements set by finance.

**About The Role

**We're seeking a Quality Engineer to build our testing capabilities and quality assurance practices from the ground up. This is a high-impact role where you'll help establish the best practices, standards, and culture that define how we deliver quality software at TimeLog. You'll have the opportunity to influence our testing strategy from scratch while working hands-on to implement automated test suites across our web applications and APIs. The role is based in Denmark. Please see Practicalities below before applying.

At TimeLog, we're looking for someone who embodies a "Product Engineer" mindset. Someone who doesn't see QA as a gatekeeper role, but as an enabler of quality throughout the development process. You'll take end-to-end responsibility for quality outcomes, working collaboratively with development teams rather than as a final checkpoint. Your success will be measured by how well you enable engineering teams to build quality into their work from the start.

As part of a small, focused team, you'll be expected to take initiative and lead the technical direction for all things quality. This is both a hands-on technical role (building test suites, writing automation code) and a strategic leadership position (defining what to automate versus manually test, determining where to invest effort for maximum impact). You'll have significant autonomy and influence over how we approach quality across the entire organization.

Key responsibilities

• Design and build automated end-to-end test suites for our web applications and APIs using modern testing frameworks like Playwright.

• Establish and evangelize testing standards, best practices, and patterns across Product Development teams.

• Develop and implement a comprehensive regression testing strategy that ensures release confidence while minimizing test execution time.

• Make strategic decisions about what to automate versus manually test, optimizing for bug detection impact relative to effort invested.

• Ensure quality for customer migrations from our legacy product to our new cloud-native platform, including data validation and end-to-end migration testing.

• Integrate automated tests into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines to provide fast feedback on code changes.

• Over time, establish non-functional testing practices (load, performance and reliability testing) as the automation foundation matures.

• Collaborate across development teams as a QA partner and advisor.

• Create comprehensive test documentation, runbooks, and quality metrics dashboards to provide visibility into product quality.

• Upskill and mentor engineers on testing practices, test design principles, and automation techniques.

• Implement test monitoring and observability to track test effectiveness, flakiness, and coverage over time.

• Determine appropriate test environment strategies and test data management approaches that support efficient testing workflows.

Required experience and skills

**Testing expertise

**

• Extensive experience with end-to-end test automation using frameworks like Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar tools.

• Strong knowledge of API testing approaches and tools for REST services.

• Deep understanding of test design principles including test pyramids, coverage strategies, and risk-based testing.

• Proven experience building test infrastructure and automation frameworks from scratch.

**CI/CD and DevOps

**

• Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, preferably with Azure DevOps.

• Understanding of deployment patterns, release processes, and how testing fits into continuous delivery workflows.

• Experience with test environment management, test data strategies, and managing test dependencies.

**Technical Skills

**

• Strong programming and scripting abilities. Comfortable writing maintainable test code and automation scripts (C#/.NET experience is a plus given our Microsoft technology stack).

• Solid understanding of web application architecture, HTTP/REST APIs, and modern web technologies.

• Proficiency with Git version control and experience working in agile development environments.

• Comfortable working in both Linux and Windows environments.

Nice to have

• Hands-on experience with load and performance testing tools such as k6, JMeter or Azure Load Testing, and the ability to reason about system behaviour under load and identify bottlenecks.

• Familiarity with performance monitoring and observability practices, and with instrumenting tests for diagnosability.

• Experience with the Microsoft testing ecosystem including xUnit, NUnit, and Azure DevOps Test Plans for test case management and exploratory testing.

• Knowledge of .NET/C# development and familiarity with the Microsoft development toolchain.

• Container and Kubernetes testing experience, including testing in containerized environments.

• Security testing practices and vulnerability assessment experience.

• Knowledge of compliance and regulatory testing requirements in enterprise software.

• Familiarity with chaos engineering and reliability testing practices.

• Experience testing data pipelines and ETL processes, including data quality validation, schema testing, and pipeline reliability (e.g., in Databricks, Apache Spark, or similar platforms).

• Familiarity with data testing frameworks such as Great Expectations, dbt tests, or similar tools for asserting data correctness and completeness.

What We're Looking For

• Ownership mentality that extends beyond writing tests to caring about overall quality outcomes and customer satisfaction.

• Platform/QA-as-a-product thinking: treating testing infrastructure and capabilities as products you're building for internal engineering customers.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to explain testing concepts to engineers, product managers, and leadership alike.

• Interest in understanding the business context and product strategy behind testing requirements.

Practicalities

• Location: this is a hybrid role with regular on-site presence at one of our offices (Copenhagen, Aarhus or Aalborg). It is not a remote position, including from elsewhere in the Nordics.

• Eligibility: you must already live in Denmark, or commute daily across the Øresund, and hold the right to work here. We are not able to offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role.

• Language: the working language in Product Development is English. Danish is a plus, not a requirement.

What you'll gain

• Work with modern testing tools, frameworks, and cloud-native technologies in an Azure/Microsoft environment.

• Collaborate with talented engineering teams on challenging technical problems.

• Shape the quality culture and testing practices for the entire engineering organization.

• Professional development in emerging QA practices, automation techniques, and modern testing approaches.

We value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who meet the core requirements and share our passion for building quality software that delights customers.

Don't wait. We're excited to welcome your application today!

**Help shape quality and protect lives through vaccines

**Are you an experienced QA Specialist who can navigate complexity, influence stakeholders, and create progress in a dynamic manufacturing environment?

At Bavarian Nordic in Kvistgaard, we develop and manufacture life-saving vaccines that protect people around the world.

We are looking for a QA Specialist to join our QA Drug Product team and help strengthen quality, compliance, and continuous improvement across our manufacturing operations.

**Your role

**As a QA Specialist, you will work closely with Production and other functions to provide clear quality direction, resolve complex issues, and ensure that critical activities progress in a compliant and timely manner.

You will manage a varied portfolio of operational QA activities, investigations, and improvement initiatives, often with competing priorities and deadlines. You must therefore be able to maintain an overview, make sound risk-based decisions, and drive activities through to completion.

This is an individual-contributor role without formal people-management responsibility. You will lead through expertise, credibility, and influence, building alignment while maintaining an independent QA position.

You will report to the Head of QA Drug Product and join a skilled and collaborative team committed to quality excellence, knowledge sharing, and patient safety.

**Your Responsibilities

**As a QA Specialist, you will:

• Provide clear QA direction and trusted advice to Production and cross-functional stakeholders

• Review and approve Deviations, CAPAs, Change Controls, batch documentation, SOPs, and other GMP-relevant records within your delegated authority

• Perform QA oversight of Drug Product manufacturing and support timely product disposition

• Lead the resolution of complex quality issues and investigations

• Apply quality risk management to identify pragmatic and compliant solutions

• Represent QA in cross-functional projects, forums, and improvement initiatives

• Identify quality and compliance risks and ensure timely escalation and follow-up

• Support inspection readiness and represent QA during inspections, audits, and other significant compliance activities

• Improve quality processes, standards, and ways of working

• Share knowledge and contribute to a strong and proactive quality culture

**What You Bring

**We expect you to have:

• A relevant degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, or a related discipline

• Typically, five or more years of relevant QA experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or vaccine manufacturing

• Strong knowledge of GMP, Process Validation, QMS, and applicable regulatory expectations

• Experience leading complex quality activities, investigations, or cross-functional projects

• A broad understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes and cross-functional dependencies

• The ability to manage several priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously

• Strong risk-based decision-making and problem-solving skills

• Professional proficiency in English and Danish is a requirement

**How You Work

**You establish credibility through your expertise, judgement, and consistent delivery. You communicate clearly and diplomatically, listen to different perspectives, and build commitment without relying on formal authority.

You remain calm and effective when priorities change, constructively challenge decisions when quality or compliance may be at risk, and move activities forward even when the situation is complex or information is incomplete.

**About The Team And Department

**You will join a competent and supportive QA Drug Product team. The team currently consists of six colleagues and will grow to seven with this hire. The group represents a healthy mix of experienced QA specialists, fostering collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development.

You will also become part of our QA Operations department, comprising approximately 40 employees across sites in Kvistgaard, Denmark, and Munich, Germany. The department is characterized by close cross-site collaboration, a strong quality mindset, and a shared commitment to delivering safe and compliant products to patients.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**At Bavarian Nordic, your work will contribute directly to the development and production of life-saving vaccines. We offer:

• Meaningful work with an impact on patients and global health

• A collaborative, inclusive, and international working environment

• A broad role with significant cross-functional interaction

• Opportunities for professional and personal development

• Competitive salary, pension, health insurance, bonus opportunity, and employee benefits

• Flexible working arrangements combining on-site and remote work, depending on the activities involved

• Access to our canteen, staff club, fitness benefits, EV charging stations, and convenient transportation options

**For us, it is all about improving and saving lives together

**We are a fully integrated vaccine company focused on the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of life-saving vaccines, and one of the largest pure-play vaccine companies in the world. You will be part of a global team of more than 1600 dedicated employees with diverse backgrounds and viewpoints, who are bound together by our commitment to protect lives every day.

**Are you ready to join us in our mission?

**If this sounds like the next step in your career, we would love to hear from you.

We look forward to receiving your application together with your CV. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Join us at Karo Healthcare on our exciting journey. We're currently looking for a Key Account Manager, Pharmacy for our office in Copenhagen.

The short version

A venture-backed Danish medical imaging company is hiring its first dedicated AI/ML scientist. The company has a CE-marked product already in clinical use and is now building the next generation of diagnostic tools on top of the imaging data that product generates.

This is not a role where you inherit a dataset and a backlog. The data largely does not exist yet. Part of this job is going out to hospitals, working alongside clinicians, and finding out whether the data they hold actually contains the answer to the question they are asking. The other part is turning that into methods and working prototypes.

If you want a clean pipeline and a defined problem, this is the wrong role. If you want to define the problem, it is close to ideal.

The company

Venture-backed, Danish, around 40 people, with offices in Copenhagen. The technology is PET-based functional imaging that produces quantitative measurements rather than pictures alone — the ability to put a number on physiological function, not just describe what an image looks like.

The first product is CE-marked and in clinical use, with a pivotal trial running and a regulatory submission planned in the United States. Quantification is the core of the company’s value: it is what competitors do not offer, and it is the thing this role is hired to extend.

The company is named at first conversation. We have not put it in writing here.

The mission

The imaging data is the future product line. Today the company measures blood flow in the heart. The question is what else the same data can answer – in cardiology, in neurology, and beyond – and what methods are needed to get there.

You are hired to answer that. You will be the company’s dedicated AI/ML voice, joining a software team of eight and reporting to the Head of Software. You will work across R&D, clinical development, quality and regulatory.

Concretely, the first twelve months look like this:

• Building working relationships with clinicians and technicians at partner hospitals, in Denmark and nearby

• Getting into clinics and understanding how the scans are actually acquired and read

• Identifying which data holds real signal — and being honest when it does not

• Running studies and projects alongside hospital doctors

• Building prototypes that show whether a method works

Success at six months is measured in relationships and prototypes, not in shipped features.

What you will actually do

• Invent, prototype and mature algorithms for extracting clinically meaningful information from PET data

• Translate clinical and scientific questions into testable algorithmic solutions

• Build the pipelines around the work — acquisition, quality control, processing, visualisation, presentation of findings

• Go to hospitals. Observe workflows. Ask clinicians what they need and validate that your assumptions survive contact with clinical reality

• Evaluate emerging methods and tools, and shape which directions the company invests in

• Support the AI/ML dimension of medical device compliance as methods mature toward product — CE-marking and FDA

Travel is roughly two to three days per month, primarily within Denmark and southern Sweden.

Who we are looking for

Essential

• Demonstrable AI/ML development experience — applied, and with something you can point to and say “I built that”

• A software engineering and algorithm background, hands-on with PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX or Keras, and disciplined about testing and version control

• Experience with data collection, selection, integration and quality control, and preparing datasets for training

• Comfort starting from a rough idea rather than a specification

• Someone who wants to be in the room with clinicians. This role does not work from a desk — you need to be willing to initiate conversations with doctors and technicians, ask uncomfortable questions, and keep asking

• Roughly three to eight years of relevant experience. A PhD, or a PhD plus postdoc, counts — provided the work was applied and you have built things

Strongly preferred

• Medical imaging: DICOM, and work on 3D or 4D volumetric data — segmentation, registration, classification or quantification. PET, MR or X-ray all count

• PET-specific knowledge — reconstruction, attenuation and scatter correction, tracer kinetics, quantification. Genuinely valuable, genuinely not required on day one. The company expects to teach this

• Medical device software or SaMD experience — IEC 62304, quality systems, verification and validation, CE-marking or FDA

• A background in healthcare, medtech, diagnostics or another regulated field

Education

Computer science, biomedical engineering, medical physics or similar is typical. Proven capability substitutes for credentials.

Relocation

Candidates relocating to Denmark will be considered.

What this is, honestly

The genuine appeal. This is the company’s first and only AI/ML hire. Nobody has done this before you, there is no established way of working to inherit, and the direction the company takes on AI is the direction you argue for. It is an unusual amount of ownership for someone at this level, and it is the main reason to take the role.

What you should weigh. You will be the only AI/ML person among eight developers. There is no in-house peer to review your methods and no senior imaging-AI person to learn from — the clinical and scientific expertise sits with the company’s hospital collaborators and advisors rather than inside the building. Some people find that liberating. Others find it isolating, and it is worth being honest with yourself about which you are before you apply.

The other thing to weigh is the data. It is early. Expect to spend real time on access, agreements, site visits and data quality before you spend it on model architecture.

Interested, or want to know more?

Black Swans Exist is running this search exclusively. We will tell you who the company is at first conversation, and we will tell you the parts that are not in this document.

If it is not right for you but you know who it is right for, we would genuinely like to hear from you.

The Department of Biomedicine at the Faculty of Health at Aarhus University invites applications for a position as Assistant Professor in the field of experimental virology as per 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is a fixed-term full-time position for 18 months.

The Department of Biomedicine focuses on innovation, entrepreneurship and collaboration with business and industry, and numerous researchers from the department have established companies to develop new medicinal treatments founded in professional scientific basic research. Your job responsibilities
As Assistant Professor in Experimental Virology, your primary tasks will be research and research-based teaching. You will teach and supervise students at Bachelor’s and Master’s level, and you will contribute to the development of the department through research of high international quality. In your daily work, you will work closely with both Danish and international colleagues. The position of Assistant Professor is a career development position in which you will receive supervision and pedagogical upgrading.

Your main tasks will consist of:

 * Independent research of high international quality on virus-host interactions, innate immune sensing and inflammasome signalling during RNA-virus infection, including publication of the results.

 * Establishment and characterisation of relevant cellular and cancer-associated experimental models to study how innate sensing pathways influence viral replication, cell death and oncolytic-virus responses.

 * Multiple RNA-virus systems and comparative virus-host studies; experience with VSV or another experimentally tractable negative-strand RNA virus is highly relevant.

 * Mechanisms connecting viral infection with inflammatory signalling, type-I interferon responses, cell death, cellular metabolism, mitochondrial function and/or reactive oxygen species.

jobs.description:
We are searching for a skilled and experienced post doc with specific interest in investigating early myeloid disease, clonal haematopoiesis, metabolism and obesity.

Our research/The group

The focus of the Grønbæk group is Translational Haematology. The group is affiliated with Biotech Research and Innovation centre (BRIC), University of Copenhagen and Rigshospitalet (Central Copenhagen University Hospital).

Our overall aim is to understand the molecular mechanisms of haematological cancers and based on this; to design, develop and implement novel, scientifically based, clinical trials, with a strong focus on epigenetic therapies. This is done by bridging between clinical research at Rigshospitalet and the basic cancer biology research at BRIC, and in international collaborations with, among others, the Van Andel Research Institute, Michigan, USA and the Nordic MDS study group.

Our location at the Copenhagen Biocentre/BRIC provides optimal conditions for interaction with the basic scientists at BRIC. The group currently consists of 14 scientists, MD/scientists and students, one clinical research coordinator, 1 research nurse and 2 biomedical laboratory scientists.

The project: Deciphering the Mechanistic Links Between Obesity, Clonal Haematopoiesis and Myeloid Neoplasms.

The current position is part of a joint project ‘Deciphering the Mechanistic Links Between Obesity, Clonal Haematopoiesis and Myeloid Neoplasms’ together with Professor George Vassiliou, Cambridge Stem Cell Institute, University of Cambridge, United Kingdom funded by a ‘Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC)’ grant from the Novo Nordisk foundation, which supports collaborative research projects with the purpose ‘t_o reverse-translate clinical observations into mechanistic studies that will increase our understanding of how obesity impacts carcinogenesis’.

Obesity is a global health issue linked to increased risk of cancer, including blood cancers such as myeloid neoplasms (MN). Many MN arise from clonal haematopoiesis (CH)—the abnormal expansion of blood stem cell clones carrying somatic mutations. Haematopoietic stem cells interact with bone marrow adipose tissue (BMAT), which increases with obesity, which may fuel CH growth and progression to MN. Epidemiological and genetic studies already suggest obesity accelerates CH, but the underlying mechanisms remain unclear.

This project integrates large-scale population data, clinical trials, and mechanistic mouse studies to investigate these links and explore preventive or therapeutic strategies.

Your job

The project focuses on translational analyses of live frozen human cells from patient bone marrow (BM)/(BMAT) and blood samples from completed and ongoing clinical trials. We are searching for a skilled post doc who is very interactive and enjoys collaborations with other scientists – including younger scientists and clinician scientists.

Your tasks will include:

• Process of live frozen patient material from clinical trials including isolation of defined cell populations, and quality control for downstream omics

• Perform in-house molecular techniques which may include Proteomics, PCR, ddPCR, and library/sample preparation for RNA-seq, ATAC-seq and DNA methylation analyses

• Coordinate genomic, transcriptomic, lipidomic, metabolomic analyses with our internal and external collaborating laboratories and take the lead on designing relevant sub-studies, integrating and interpreting the data

• Help establish the practical and regulatory framework for these collaborations, including material transfer and data-sharing agreements

• Participate in grant and manuscript writing

• Present at local and international meetings

• Introduce lab techniques to new lab members and students

• Collaborate with both scientists and clinicians

Start: February 1st, 2027

Duration: 2 years

Profile

We expect you to be a highly motivated and highly ambitious, independent scientist with the following qualifications: •

• A PhD in Life Sciences with a preferred focus on haematology

• A strong background in mechanisms of normal and malignant haematopoiesis and molecular haematology techniques

• Comprehensive lab skills in molecular and cellular biology techniques, including work with primary human cells and cryopreserved patient material

• Experience with genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, lipidomics, metabolomics and ability to analyse and interpret such data

• Experience with running projects across research groups

• Strong publication and presentation record in peer reviewed journals and international conferences

• Excellent written and spoken English skills

• Very collaborative

• Good social skills

Place of employment

The workplace is at the Bartholin Institute which is part of Rigshospitalet, University of Copenhagen. The Bartholin Institute is located at Copenhagen Biocentre/BRIC, close to the centre of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and a number of core facilities (animal unit, flow cytometry, in vivo imaging, NGS, etc.) shared between the research groups at BRIC (www.bric.ku.dk) and the neighbouring Finsen Laboratory. We have weekly journal clubs, data clubs, seminars with invited speakers and a young researchers club ASAP and our own PhD programme, MoMeD.

Terms of employment

The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of two years. The starting date is 01.02.2027 or after agreement.

Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 39,900 DKK/approx. 5,300 EUR (August 2026 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18,07 % to your pension fund.

Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions, if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025

Questions

Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

Application

The application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:

1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page).

2. CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position.

3. A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do.

4. List of publications.

Recommendation

Furthermore, the applicant should provide two letters of recommendation or two references. To be taken into consideration, the letters must be signed by the supporting person on paper with institutional letter head and in PDF-format.

Application deadline 15 November 2026, 23.59pm CET.
